South Campground: 46 electric (20/30A) sites 25-35 ft, mostly back-in, and 3 walk-to sites. Besides these, 2 host sites, a youth group site and 4 camping cabins. Every drive-in site is 25 ft or longer.

note: Iowa DNR park on a timbered peninsula on the north side of Rathbun Lake (distinct from the adjacent state-owned Honey Creek Resort), in North and South campgrounds either side of the park road; six-lane boat ramp. The south end of the South Campground looks out over the lake. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20/30/50A, 16 full hookups, showers, dump, 100% reservable. Sites 118 -> 106 (counted cabins/hosts), max rig 35 -> 90 (FHU pull-throughs); season Apr 1-Oct 31 -> year-round per RA. Waterfront lead: not waterfront -> lakeview (RA photos of 122 and 124 show the lake). Pin ~590 m off; corrected.
flags: WATERFRONT (upgrade lead: not waterfront -> lakeview): every RA site is tagged 'Near Water - no', but RA's own photos of South Campground sites 122 and 124 (Standard Electric back-ins, 30-35 ft) show open Rathbun Lake water past the picnic table, and 120 shows sky through the same tree line. On NAIP sites 116-124 face south across open lawn with scattered trees to the shore about 90-130 m away; the loop road runs behind them. Too far and too treed for lakefront, but a view from several RV sites meets the filtered-view rule. The rest of the South loop and all of the North loop are in woods 150 m+ from water.

PIN (~590 m off): stored 40.86540,-92.93470 is north of both loops. RA site points: North Campground centres on 40.86159,-92.93396, South on 40.85829,-92.93347. Proposed 40.8601,-92.9337 (the campground entrance junction between them).

SEASON: stored Apr 1-Oct 31 (note prose) is contradicted: ReserveAmerica says 'Status: Open year round' and reservations are taken year round. Written year-round; restrooms/showers close late October to mid-April.

SITES: stored 118 matched RA's total listing, which includes 4 cabins, 2 host sites and a youth group site. 106 public campsites; the stored max_rig_ft 35 ignored the 16 full-hookup pull-throughs (45-90 ft).
RA bulletin typo: 'Modern restrooms will reopen in mid-April 2026' (posted 10/16/2026); the DNR alert says mid-April 2027.
